categories.main_business_segments: Contemporary Amperex Technology Co., Ltd. (CATL) primarily operates in the development, manufacturing, and sales of lithium-ion batteries, including power battery systems for electric vehicles, energy storage battery systems, and battery materials and recycling. The company also engages in emerging applications such as batteries for engineering machinery, ships, and aircraft, and provides integrated energy solutions and battery recycling services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: CATL leverages advanced electrochemical, thermodynamic, and molecular dynamics research to develop high-performance lithium-ion batteries with various chemistries including lithium iron phosphate, ternary nickel-cobalt-manganese, sodium-ion, M3P, and solid-state batteries. The company employs proprietary technologies such as CTP (cell-to-pack) and CTC (cell-to-chassis) for battery integration, intelligent design platforms, and green extreme manufacturing processes to achieve high energy density, fast charging, long cycle life, and safety. It also utilizes digitalization, intelligent manufacturing, and extensive R&D to maintain technological leadership.
categories.primary_customers_markets: CATL serves a broad global customer base including leading automotive manufacturers such as BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Volkswagen, Ford, Toyota, Hyundai, Volvo, and prominent Chinese EV makers like NIO, Li Auto, and Geely. Its products are used in passenger vehicles (BEV, PHEV, HEV), commercial vehicles, energy storage systems for utilities, industrial and commercial sectors, and data centers. The company also collaborates with energy groups and storage system integrators worldwide.
categories.geographic_coverage: CATL operates globally with manufacturing bases and R&D centers across China and overseas locations including Germany, Hungary, Spain, Indonesia, Mexico, Argentina, Australia, and others. Its sales and operations cover domestic Chinese markets and international markets in Europe, North America, and Asia, with overseas sales accounting for over 30% of total revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: CATL operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the lithium-ion battery supply chain, focusing on battery cell production, module and pack assembly, system integration, and battery recycling. It also invests upstream in raw material mining and processing to secure key battery materials such as lithium, nickel, cobalt, and phosphorus.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include advancing revolutionary battery technologies, expanding scale and commercial application of power and energy storage batteries, and promoting integrated innovation in electrification and digitalization. CATL emphasizes four innovation systems: materials and material system innovation, system structure innovation, green extreme manufacturing innovation, and business model innovation. It pursues zero-carbon strategies, digital and intelligent manufacturing, and global capacity expansion to support sustainable growth.
categories.revenue_model: CATL generates revenue primarily through the sale of power battery systems, energy storage battery systems, and battery materials. It also earns income from battery recycling services, licensing, and strategic partnerships. The company’s revenue is largely product sales-based, supplemented by investment income and service fees.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: CATL is the global leader in lithium-ion battery manufacturing, holding the largest market share worldwide in both power batteries for new energy vehicles and energy storage batteries. It ranks first globally for eight consecutive years in power battery usage and four consecutive years in energy storage battery shipments, significantly ahead of its nearest competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, CATL reported consolidated revenue of approximately RMB 362 billion, a slight decline from the previous year, with net profit attributable to shareholders increasing by 15% to about RMB 50.7 billion. The company achieved a lithium-ion battery sales volume of 475 GWh, growing 21.8% year-over-year. It maintains strong cash flow generation and continues to invest heavily in R&D and capacity expansion, reflecting a robust growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: CATL differentiates itself through comprehensive R&D capabilities, a broad and advanced product portfolio covering multiple battery chemistries and applications, and strong customer collaboration. Its batteries offer high energy density, fast charging, long life, safety, and adaptability to diverse climates and use cases. The company’s integrated solutions, zero-carbon initiatives, and innovative business models provide customers with reliable, sustainable, and cutting-edge energy storage and power solutions.
